Place Light: story note Kamino Ward.name: Place Light: story note Kamino Ward

effects.instruction: Narrator only: since the Kamino Incident the heart of Kamino Ward, around its shopping street, is a ruin from All Might's last battle with All For One: collapsed buildings, rubble heaps, hazard tape and cones, rebuilding crews by day and floodlit cordons by night. Describe it that way, never as the intact ward.
